summary: BrainsWay Ltd., an Israeli medical device firm, filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results and operational highlights. The release details a 35% revenue increase to $17.1 million, record shipments of 125 Deep TMS systems, and raised FY2026 guidance. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed; it is a routine quarterly earnings announcement under the 6-K format. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements, and no deal terms or extraordinary corporate actions are present. Investors should monitor ordinary operational performance and guidance updates.
